question: Should the Settings-only navigation model intentionally remove existing users’ persisted `route:custodian` sidebar pins, with Settings → Ask OpenClaw as the sole supported entry point?
rationale: The branch deliberately rewrites a persisted user navigation preference; focused tests cover the normalization, but whether that upgrade behavior is the desired product contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Confirm the Settings-only migration
options.body: Accept removal of stale Custodian pins once real upgraded-session proof shows the page remains discoverable and renders with Settings chrome.

options.title: Preserve an upgrade transition
options.body: Keep or surface a one-time migration affordance for existing pinned layouts if maintainers want the user’s prior navigation choice to remain visible during upgrade.

recommendation.title: Confirm the Settings-only migration
recommendation.body: Accept removal of stale Custodian pins once real upgraded-session proof shows the page remains discoverable and renders with Settings chrome.

likelyOwner.reason: The sole branch commit and PR rationale define the proposed navigation and persisted-layout migration.
